name: KY-016 RGB LED (5 mm)
not_buildable: Each colour needs its own series resistor and an output pin. It is an output part, and LearnLens sketches may only switch the board's own LEDs so far.
identification: Small black PCB with a clear 5 mm LED standing upright and 4 angled header pins labelled R, G, B, -.

facts.statement: Red, green and blue LED with a common cathode; forward voltage 1.8 V (red) and 2.8 V (green, blue) at 20 mA.
